name: verse19_spine
title: VerSe 2019: 160 spine CTs with vertebra-level label maps and centroids
description: The Large Scale Vertebrae Segmentation Challenge 2019 (training, validation and test splits, 80 + 40 + 40 scans): spine CT in NIfTI with a 28-class vertebra label map and a JSON of vertebra centroids per scan. Three zips on the BoneScreen S3 bucket read scan by scan with HTTP Range. VerSe 2020 is the same layout under dataset-verse20*.zip.

license.note: CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated in the VerSe repository (checked 2026-10-14).

citation: Sekuboyina A., Husseini M.E., Bayat A., et al. VerSe: A Vertebrae labelling and segmentation benchmark for multi-detector CT images. Med Image Anal 73:102166, 2021.

ct.description: Spine CT (NIfTI); field split = training / validation / test

mask.description: Vertebra label map (VerSe convention: 1-7 cervical, 8-19 thoracic, 20-25 lumbar, 26 sacrum, 27 cocygis, 28 T13)
